description: Weekdays on which Federal Reserve Banks are closed for a holiday, used by app/tools.py to count business days. Assumption stated in every tool result: business days are Monday to Friday except these dates. Reg E defines a business day as a day the consumer's own institution is open (12 CFR 1005.2(d)); a bank open on Saturdays or on a holiday counts differently.
weekend_rule: A holiday on a Saturday closes no weekday (Federal Reserve Banks are open the preceding Friday). A holiday on a Sunday closes the following Monday.
sources: 2025 is derived from the same holiday rules (fixed dates and nth weekdays); the Federal Reserve pages no longer list 2025. tests/test_tools.py checks that these rules reproduce the published 2026 and 2027 tables.
